name: I/O Image
summary: Adversaries may seek to capture process values related to the inputs and outputs of a PLC. During the scan cycle, a PLC reads the status of all inputs and stores them in an image table. The image table is the PLCs internal storage location where values of inputs/outputs for one scan are stored while it executes the user program. After the PLC has solved the entire logic program, it updates the output image table. The contents of this output…

analytics.name: Analytic 1906
analytics.guidance: Collecting information from the I/O image requires analyzing the application program running on the PLC for specific data block reads. Detecting this requires obtaining and analyzing a PLC’s application program, either directly from the device or from asset management platforms.
